As a solution architect and backend developer, develop proper standard backend and frontend using reusable design and SOLID principles. Backend requirements: notification system with SSE and WebSocket realtime communication; .env and application.properties setup; AOP logger; security; optional class; proper exception handling; multithreading and synchronization used properly; standard REST architecture; profiles prod/dev/test; entity, DTO, repository, service, controller; CORS; JWT; easy debugging logger; transaction management with @Transactional and JPA; caching; scheduling; timeouts, retry, circuit breaker and fallback; @Async/thread pool; avoid deadlocks; security, CORS, CSRF, secret configuration; testing with JUnit/Mockito/Actuator health check; Grafana and Splunk monitoring; Liquibase migrations; JVM memory and GC configuration; generate runnable JAR; real-time WhatsApp messages.
title: CarePilot HMS Production-Readiness Upgrade

assessment_snapshot.intro: The current CarePilot prototype provides a starting point for the requested HMS upgrade:
bullets: Frontend: React 19.3.1 + Vite 8.3.4; current design tokens and responsive styling are in frontend/src/styles.css.
Backend: Spring Boot 3.5.16, Java 17, Spring MVC/JPA, generic clinic-scoped REST CRUD, and persistent file-based H2; schema is currently managed by Hibernate ddl-auto=update.
The current UI includes 12 clinic record modules and seven demo roles. Existing prototype sign-in is client-side only, not real security.

Current verification includes 10 passing Playwright UI flows, two passing Spring integration tests, and a successful Vite production build. The user's attached prototype HTML/CSS and the live CarePilot preview are available as UI references.
Production database choice, formal API compatibility policy, target SLA, privacy/compliance boundary, and WhatsApp provider/delivery mode have not been established.

proposed_outcome: Upgrade the existing CarePilot prototype in place into a maintainable, testable HMS while preserving existing user workflows and the current React/Spring Boot stack unless answers direct otherwise. Deliver modular reusable frontend and layered Spring services; standards-based REST, real authentication/authorization, safe configuration, audited observability, managed DB migrations, reliable real-time notifications, and automated verification. Keep external WhatsApp delivery disabled or in a safe test mode until its provider, consent, and operational requirements are agreed.
